description: Hand-computed numbers of the axonometric depiction. Shading: the light is (-0.45, 0.78, 0.5) normalised in view space; a face with unit normal n is lit by max(0, n.light) and falls in band 3 above 0.75, 2 above 0.5, 1 above 0.25, else 0; the shadow share of the bands 0..2 is 0.36, 0.24, 0.12 towards #001117. normals are (x, y, z) in view space (x right, y up, z towards the viewer). lit = n.light is hand-computed with |light| = sqrt(0.45^2 + 0.78^2 + 0.5^2) = 1.0307764.

joins.description: two bars crossing in view space: horizontal [0,0,0,6,1,1] and vertical [0,0,0,1,6,1.5] (centre, width, height, depth); the curves where their surfaces meet are four vertical lines (x = +-0.5, z = +-0.5, y in -0.5..0.5, length 1 each) and four lines along z (x = +-0.5, y = +-0.5, z in -0.5..0.5, length 1 each); seen from +z only the two lines at z = 0.5 have a front-facing triangle

sheetCells.third: the axonometric cell is right of the plan and above the front elevation
sheetCells.first: the axonometric cell is left of the plan and below the front elevation
